name: Shandong Tengda Fa
summary: Shandong Tengda Fasten Tech. Co., Ltd. specializes in the full lifecycle of stainless steel fastener products, from their initial design and development through manufacturing and ultimate sale. The company's offerings prominently feature essential components such as bolts, nuts, screws, and washers. Established on December 23, 2015, its main operational base is situated in Zaozhuang, China.
